# Nerio (engine probe 4 in this line's own words): 0 not made; 1 rules Athens and is of the house of Acciaioli;
# 2 rules Athens without that house (the named dynasty did not take, or the fallback without a dynasty was used);
# 3 made, no longer rules. Add 10 when the fallback was used.

    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_nerio_made }
        value = 3
        if = { limit = { oe_lgr_nerio_rules = yes } value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { oe_lgr_nerio_rules = yes c:ATH = { ruler = { has_dynasty = yes dynasty = dynasty:acciaioli_dynasty } } } value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_lgr_nerio_made = 2 } add = 10 }

}
# Corinth: 1 the empire, 2 ATH, 3 ACH, 4 someone else; add 10 when la3 moved it to Athens.
oe_lgr_rd_corinth = {
    value = 4
    if = { limit = { location:corinth = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } value = 1 }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ATH location:corinth = { owner ?= c:ATH } } value = 2 }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ACH location:corinth = { owner ?= c:ACH } } value = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_cor_ath } add = 10 }
}

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 global_var:oe_lgr_chk_ep14 = 1 } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 global_var:oe_lgr_chk_ep14 = 5 } add = 500 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 global_var:oe_lgr_chk_ep14 = 9 } add = 900 }
}
# Results, 0 while unset: Thessaly taken by the sultan (1), Salona given up (1).
oe_lgr_v_tfell = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_thessaly_fell } value = global_var:oe_lgr_thessaly_fell } }
oe_lgr_v_sfell = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_salona_fell } value = global_var:oe_lgr_salona_fell } }
# The four results in one number: ones Thessaly (1 taken by the sultan), tens Salona (1 given up), hundreds Ioannina
# (oe_lgr_ioa_st: 1 built, 2 Esau, 3 the Tocco, 4 never built, 6 the sultan's), thousands Arta (oe_lgr_arta:
# 1 Losha, 2 Spata, 3 the Tocco, 4 the sultan's).
oe_lgr_rd_fall = { value = oe_lgr_v_tfell add = { value = oe_lgr_v_sfell multiply = 10 } add = { value = oe_lgr_v_ioa multiply = 100 } add = { value = oe_lgr_v_arta multiply = 1000 } }
# The BYZ variables: .13 (1 ships, 2 advised to seek Athens, 3 nothing), .14 (1 took the exiles in, 2 friendship with

oe_lgr_v_st14 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_14 } value = var:oe_lgr_st_14 } }

# Esau (ep8): 0 not made, 1 made with the house of Buondelmonti, 2 without it (the fallback).
oe_lgr_rd_esau = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_esau_made } value = global_var:oe_lgr_esau_made } }

# ---- phase 4 (the late years of Latin Greece)
# BYZ scope. Months since D4's oe_lat.12 was first seen after .20 a (-1 while not seen).
oe_lgr_since_hex = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_hex_seen has_variable = oe_lgr_m } value = var:oe_lgr_m subtract = var:oe_lgr_hex_seen } }
# BYZ scope. Readouts. World steps la5-la8 (ones la5 ... thousands la8): 0 not yet, 1 done, 2 window passed, 3 skipped.
oe_lgr_rd_ws4 = {

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la6 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la6 = 2 } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la6 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la6 = 3 } add = 30 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la7 = 1 } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la7 = 2 } add = 200 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la7 = 3 } add = 300 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la8 = 1 } add = 1000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la8 = 2 } add = 2000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8 global_var:oe_lgr_ws_la8 = 3 } add = 3000 }
}
